headline: President Clinton signed an order adjusting certain pay rates and allowances, likely for federal workers, at the end of 1995.
what_it_does: This executive order adjusts certain rates of pay and allowances. No summary was provided, so the exact groups and amounts are not known from the source. Orders with this title are usually the yearly orders that set new pay rates for federal government jobs.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may have been changed, but the source does not say which pay systems or by how much.
